items.question: How are service credits given to Voss-Lindqvist?
items.answer: Service credits are given to Voss-Lindqvist AB based on the availability of services provided by Harrowgate Systems Inc. According to the side letter, Provider will make the Services available at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance notified at least five (5) business days in advance [1]. For each full hour of unavailability below that level, Client will receive a service credit of five percent (5%) of the monthly subscription fee [1]. Service credits in any calendar month are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month [1].

items.question: Is liability for breach of confidentiality limited by the MSA's cap?
items.answer:
The MSA's liability cap applies to the total aggregate liability of each party. Clause 8.1 states that the total liability shall not exceed the greater of USD 250,000 or the fees paid by the client in the previous twelve months [1].

However, the documents also mention that the board authorised the renewal of the MSA with a liability cap not reduced below USD 400,000 [3]. This suggests that the original cap of USD 250,000 may have been amended to a higher amount.

The documents do not clarify whether this change was formally incorporated into the MSA. If the amendment is in force, the liability cap would be USD 400,000. Otherwise, it remains capped at USD 250,000.

evidence.quote: Each party's total aggregate liability arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of USD 250,000 or the Fees paid by Client in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
the liability cap is not reduced below USD 400,000
